findings.problem: The `why-evidence-list-<order>` container is rendered for every FACT/INFERENCE step, including steps whose `evidenceIds` is empty. The slice test contract (future-result.md, 'WHY panel') requires 'container absent when `evidenceIds` is empty'. The R2 test case with 0 ids (why-panel.spec.ts:304-316) only counts the chips and does not check that the container is absent, so the deviation goes undetected.
findings.fix: Change the condition to `@if ((s.informationClass === 'FACT' || s.informationClass === 'INFERENCE') && (s.evidenceIds?.length ?? 0) > 0)`. In R2, add `expect(!!byId('why-evidence-list-1')).toBe(evidenceIds.length > 0)`.

findings.problem: The spec's file table names two components, `why-panel.ts` (`app-why-panel`, output `evidenceSelected`) and `sources-panel.ts` (`app-sources-panel`, input `highlightedId`), with `whyOpen`/`sourcesOpen`/`highlightedId` held in `FutureResultComponent`. The build ships one combined `app-why-sources` component that holds all the state. Observable behaviour and test ids match, but the structure differs from the spec.
findings.fix: Split into the two specified components, or update the spec's file table to describe the combined component.

findings.problem: The spec says `why-panel` and `sources-panel` are each a `mat-card`. Both are rendered as plain `<section>` elements without Material card styling, so they look inconsistent with the other Material surfaces of the result view.
findings.fix: Import MatCardModule and render each panel as `<mat-card data-testid=...>` with `mat-card-content`.

findings.problem: Orphaned doc comment `/** "ORACUL FUTURE — March 1, 2027" -> "2027-03-01" */` describes a helper that no longer exists. It is attached to nothing and misleads readers.

The R1 rows pass a constant 'E001' as an unused first parameter (`_id`). The title template 'R1 %s: %i sources render %i items in API order' has three placeholders but only two values, so the test names come out as e.g. 'R1 E001: 0 sources render %i items', which is misleading.
findings.fix: Drop the unused column and use the title '%i sources render that many items in API order'.
